headline: Madison Mayor Satya Rhodes-Conway announced she is dropping reelection bid
summary: Madison Mayor Satya Rhodes-Conway ends reelection bid citing safety concerns; protest encampment clearance and firing of independent police monitor preceded decision.

headline: First influenza-related death of 2026-27 season reported in Idaho
summary: Idaho reports its first flu-related death this season, an Owyhee County man over 65. Flu activity is rising, with more emergency visits than last year. Annual flu shots are recommended, especially for high-risk individuals like the elderly and those with chronic conditions. Public health officials remind Idahoans to practice good hygiene and stay home when sick to prevent spread.

headline: Immigrants in ICE detention have no due process rights under US Constitution, federal appeals court says
summary: The 5th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that immigrants entering the U.S. without appointments can be detained indefinitely without bond, affecting over 20,000 detainees in Texas, Louisiana, and Mississippi. This decision overturns an earlier ruling that granted bond hearings after 90 days, and has far-reaching implications for immigrants' rights to due process.

headline: ‘A botch job’: Federal appeals court reverses injunction, reassigns anti-DEI case
summary: The U.S. 5th Circuit Court of Appeals reversed an injunction, allowing Mississippi's law banning DEI programs in public schools to take effect. The law, as interpreted, does not apply to students and allows exemptions for scholarly work and creative engagement.

headline: Jackson changes course after initially saying he would skip second Trump rally this month
summary: Republican gubernatorial nominee Rick Jackson reverses course, confirming attendance at President Trump's rally in Perry after initially opting to campaign with Gov. Kemp in Cherokee. Democrats criticize Jackson's alignment with Trump, using it to tie him to unpopular policies.

headline: ICE agents arrested U.S. citizen at gunpoint in Charlotte, NC immigration advocates say
summary: U.S. citizen Atilio Portillo was arrested by ICE agents at gunpoint while driving to work in Charlotte, NC. Despite identifying himself as a U.S. citizen, agents handcuffed him and detained him for 30 minutes before releasing him. His brother, also a U.S. citizen, was taken into custody. This incident follows a pattern of ICE agents detaining U.S. citizens without warrants in North Carolina, with advocates worrying about increased cases due to the state's cooperation with ICE under SB 153.
